Previous Next Vacant 2 x Bedroom House Freehold mid-terrace house comprising, an open plan living room, kitchen, bathroom and utility room on the ground floor. To the first floor are 2 x bedrooms, a dressing room and an ensuite shower room. The property has the benefit of a private rear garden. Situation The property is located to the west side of Saunders Park. There are a wide range of shops, cafes, bars and other amenities close by, in Lewes Road to the west of the property. Brighton mainline station is less than 2 miles from the property, (London Victoria 62 mins).
